hypothesis: R42 ab-int2: the 113 original ArchBench points (full suite) pass their numerical and structural checks on the R41 run-3 image with the registered software tree, and give its serial-grid device cycles at 100 MHz.
competing_explanations: the software tree differs from run 3 (compiler, runtime, harness) and changes cycles or numerics
a workload fails, falls back, times out, or is omitted from its registered checks
the card identity or clock changes during the run (shared card)
expected_counter_changes: baseline tree (main 4b61abd8): serial-grid cycles equal to the run-3 records within run-to-run noise
candidate tree: cycles change only where the candidate changes generated code or the runtime
no host fallback and no upload/download inside resident calls
expected_observations: every registered configuration completes with its numerical and structural checks passing
the experiment records the observed image, clock, software tree and raw results

board.load_policy: approved run-3 image; loaded only by tools/r42/board_ab.py after 15 consecutive idle minutes through program.sh --check/--go; every FPGA step checks identity

registration.name: ab-int2
changes_against_run3: id, hypothesis, competing_explanations, expected_*: R42 wording
registration: R42 block (software commit, tree identity, knobs); the run-3 block is kept as derived_from
steps[].argv --manifest and sources: the manifest is read from {home}/r42/reg/NAME/ (outside the measured tree, so the tree stays byte-equal to its commit) instead of spec/r41/run3/board/
board.memory_map.source and sources: {home}/r41run3/xclbin_hbm_map.json (same file, same sha256) instead of spec/r41/run3/xclbin_hbm_map.json, which is not in the repository
estimates: removed (only --dry-run reads them; evidence/ is not staged)

identity manifest: the `source` step (review of the frozen RTL image source archive, an R41 delivery check) and its two tool sources are removed; the clock verification and the three identity points are unchanged
optional --knob entries are added to every configuration (none for the baseline)
registration.sampling: unchanged: spec/r41/stage1/plan.json measurement.long_device_tasks (qualification record 0 warm-up + 1 timed call; a point at <= 1 s device time then gets a formal record of 3 timed calls in a new process, else the qualification record is formal)
registration.boundary: unchanged: ArchBench protocol 2, device-cycles-serial-grid at the qualified 100 MHz

run3_registration.source_scope: frozen image source separately verified; runtime tree recorded by experiment.py
inherited_expected_observations: 113 configurations pass numerically (max_rel_err <= tol), evidence_level measured-board
device cycles per point recorded for the S2-01 cycles/wall-time report vs B40

inherited_registration.coverage: spec/r40/suites/hbm.json (113 unique points) as existing.json + hbm-tier.json + large.json
inherited_registration.order: native tiny/small/medium, HBM tier, large (longest last)
inherited_registration.sampling_rule: plan.json measurement.long_device_tasks: qualification record (0 warm-up, 1 timed call); when every configuration of a group qualifies at <= 1 s, a formal record with 3 timed calls, else the qualification record is formal (1 timed call); anchors: 3 independent interleaved processes; borderline rechecks (3 more samples per arm, at most 2 blocks) only by a later registered judgement, never by repeating until significant
inherited_registration.reference: Stage 1 B40 board records of the same points and knobs (evidence/r41/stage1, evidence/r40/v3/R40-04.hbm/board_run_fe1b)

steps.timing_boundary: ArchBench protocol 2: cold call untimed; registered warm-up/timed steady calls; device-cycles-serial-grid and device-graph-makespan from first accepted launch to last device completion (MMIO common-clock endpoints); request-latency recorded, not ranked
steps.cache_state: fresh experiment-local Triton/Inductor/extension caches under {out}/caches; one ArchBench process per run
